page.content:
California AVA that became the New World's cabernet showcase.

How Napa Valley connects

  • Topic: New World wine — Napa Valley is the United States' flagship New World fine-wine region.
  • Item: Cabernet Sauvignon — Cabernet Sauvignon is Napa's prestige variety.
  • Event: Judgment of Paris — The 1976 Judgment of Paris made Napa a peer in the fine-wine story.

What is Napa Valley?

Napa Valley is the U.S. region that beat first-growth Bordeaux in the 1976 Judgment of Paris for cabernet and still organizes American fine-wine ambition.

Key threads lead to New World wine, Cabernet Sauvignon and Judgment of Paris.
